answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 36056 Country: India Title: In a hadith I heard that when the person sneezes Allah turns happy on him and when a person yawns Satan turns to be happy on him Question: In a hadith I heard that when the person sneezes Allah turns happy on him and when a person yawns Satan turns to be happy on him. From this hadith can I predict that when Allah is happy from any person he makes him sneeze and when he is not he makes him yawn, because both the actions are natural (done by Allah) no human being does it by self. Answer ID: 36056 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 193/193/M=1433) Almighty Allah is the Creator of all actions. The meaning of hadith which you explained is not right. Sneezing and yawning is not the proof of Allah's pleasure or wrath. Rather good things are attributed towards Allah while bad things towards Satan. Since after sneezing one feels a kind of relaxation and it leads towards Almighty Allah's obedience; hence it was attributed towards Allah while yawning causes laziness and inattentiveness in worship that pleases Satan; hence it was attributed towards Satan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
